text:
elaine: Heads up 0: dense marine fog rolling in near the Embarcadero. Ferry schedules getting tweaked and buses slower on the bridge. If you're leaving from the office, check before you head out. :fog: :ship:

rishi: Oh no. Any ETA on how bad? I have a toddler pickup at 6PM.

transit-bot: SF TRANSIT: Due to reduced visibility, Ferry F2 and F3 operating on adjusted schedules. Golden Gate Transit buses across the bridge are experiencing 10-25 minute delays. See https://status.sfgov.org/transit for live updates.

hana: If it helps, BART is running normal but expect crowding at Embarcadero. I grabbed us extra desk umbrellas just in case. :umbrella_with_rain_drops: 

luis: Planning to bike but probably switching to Muni. Also PSA: bring an extra pair of socks. Learned that the hard way last year.

elaine: Also office note 2nd floor kitchen table reserved at 5:30PM for team dinner. If you're OK leaving earlier/late, shout so I can cancel or keep it.

rishi: I'm heading now to make the pickup. If someone can snag the table I'm happy to reimburse Uber.

hana: I'll claim it for now. If you need a ride, I can swing by the front at 5:40.

transit-bot: Reminder: If you're delayed >15m for a meeting, please add a quick note in the meeting thread or DM the host. Saves the standby confusion.

elainE: wait typo (ignore)

elainE: *elaine sorry keyboard buttered*

luis: LOL keyboard butter. Good luck rishi.

rishi: Update: Ferry page shows F3 delayed 22 min. Deciding between waiting or driving. Kids > fog = drive.

hana: Also quick poll: who wants a takeaway soup from the lobby fridge if we cancel? React :thumbsup: for yes, :shrug: for maybe.

elainE: :thumbsup: (yes pls)

luis: :thumbsup: 

rishi: :shrug: (running late)

transit-bot: Live tip: the mobile Muni app shows vehicle positions; toggle "show realtime" to eyeball nearest buses.

hana: Thanks everyone. Table is held. If plans change, post in #random and I'll update. Stay warm and don't put your laptop under the umbrella. Learned that too. :sweat_smile: 

elainE: Leaving now. Good vibes and dry socks to all. :v:

luis: Heading out in 10. If anyone needs a lift to Caltrain, ping me.

rishi: Driving. Will be late but kiddo's safe. Much appreciated.

transit-bot: Postscript: Fog can clear quickly. Monitor updates; some routes may resume normal service within the hour.
